info.title: Odexa Inventory API
info.description: Authenticated, tenant-scoped inventory. Tenant identity comes exclusively from a verified JWT tenant_id, never a request header. Reads allow authenticated actors; adjustments require MERCHANT_ADMIN or MERCHANT_USER. SUPPORT and PLATFORM_ADMIN have no bypass. Reservations are not public HTTP operations: order.created reserves stock atomically and emits inventory.reserved or inventory.rejected on commerce.events.v1 using the order UUID as key. payment.authorized commits a hold by reducing onHand and reserved; payment.declined releases only reserved. One inventory consumer group handles all three event types with a transactional inbox. Duplicate and conflicting terminal outcomes cannot apply twice. Unknown payment outcomes keep the hold; no automatic expiry is performed.

servers.description: Direct inventory in native local development

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Product UUID, resolved only within the actor's tenant.

get.summary: Read inventory for a product in the actor's tenant
get.description: available is always onHand minus reserved. A missing stock row and a row belonging to another tenant are indistinguishable (404).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Optional HTTP entity-tag condition; a matching current ETag returns 304 without a body.

304.description: Not modified: the conditional GET matched the current version. No response body.

put.summary: Set on-hand stock using a merchant version precondition
put.description: Requires MERCHANT_ADMIN or MERCHANT_USER. Adjusts an existing row only; this is not an upsert. Stock provisioning is outside this first-slice API (local fixtures provision two products). If-Match must be one strong quoted positive version; weak tags, wildcard and lists are rejected. The database locks the stock row, checks version and requires onHand >= reserved. A successful adjustment increments version even when onHand is unchanged. Concurrent reservations and settlements also increment version, so they invalidate stale merchant ETags. A stale precondition is checked before the reserved-stock floor.

200.description: Inventory adjusted; ETag contains the new version.

bearerAuth.description: OIDC JWT with validated issuer and audience odexa-api, UUID tenant_id and nonempty sub. Write roles are read from realm_access.roles.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional UUID correlation identifier. A UUID is generated when absent; invalid values return 400.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: One strong quoted positive version no greater than 9223372036854775807. Missing returns 428, malformed returns 400, stale returns 412.

ETag.description: Strong ETag containing the quoted inventory version.

CorrelationId.description: Request correlation UUID, generated if absent.

onHand.description: Absolute physical stock count, not a delta. Must not be below the currently reserved quantity.
Physical stock before subtracting active holds.

reserved.description: Active held quantity; never exceeds onHand.

version.description: Changes on each successful adjustment, reservation, commitment or release; duplicate events do not increment it.

BadRequest.description: 400: invalid UUID, body, correlation ID or If-Match. Domain codes include INVALID_ETAG and INVALID_STOCK.

Unauthorized.description: 401: missing, expired or invalid bearer token, issuer or audience.

Forbidden.description: 403: invalid/missing tenant or subject claim, or missing merchant role for an adjustment.

NotFound.description: 404 INVENTORY_NOT_FOUND: stock row absent or in another tenant.

ReservedStockConflict.description: 409 STOCK_RESERVED: requested onHand would be below the active reserved quantity. No mutation occurs.

StaleVersion.description: 412 STALE_VERSION: If-Match does not identify the current stock version. Read again before retrying.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: 415: request content type must be application/json.

InternalError.description: 500: sanitized unexpected server error; database details are never exposed.

UnexpectedError.description: Other sanitized HTTP error, with its actual status in the problem body.
